decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a high-quality, name-brand portable speaker in new condition. The JBL Charge 4 (prod_013) is a great model but is listed as a renewed product, which raises concerns about long-term battery health. The JBL Go 3 bundle (prod_009) is significantly more expensive than the standalone speaker usually retails for and only has one negative review regarding delivery. The Bose SoundDock (prod_088) is an outdated system using a 30-pin connector. While generic options like Raymate (prod_153) and NOTABRICK (prod_168) have positive specifications, I prefer to wait for a brand-new unit from a major manufacturer for more reliable warranty and software support. Therefore, I have decided not to make a purchase today.
